## Allied Gold Provides Update on Full Power Availability at Kurmuk, Advances Toward Commercial Production and Progresses Tsenge Areas Toward Development


11/18/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 260 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/846800919/files/doc_news/2026/11/ALLIED-GOLD-PROVIDES-UPDATE-ON-FULL-POWER-AVAILABILITY-AT-KURMUK_vf.pdf)


TORONTO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Allied Gold Corporation (TSX: AAUC; NYSE: AAUC) (“Allied” or the “Company”) is pleased to provide an update on the installation of full power supply infrastructure at the Kurmuk Mine. The Company is also progressing exploration and design activities at Tsenge to support its advancement and development as an additional mining area and source of ore for the mill. The Tsenge Trend is a priority exploration and development area that the Company is advancing to increase production and extend the mine life.


**Full Power Supply Infrastructure Advancing to Commercial Production**


Following the successful grid connection energization in September, Ethiopian Electric Power, through its contractor, has begun assembling, installing and commissioning the required equipment and materials for the automated grid stabilization system. This represents an important milestone in the final phase of the power infrastructure program, as the completion of the full power system will enable the grid to meet the full load requirements of normal plant operation at the Kurmuk Mine without relying on generators. The system will ensure a stable, full-power draw from the grid, enabling sustainable increases in throughput.


In parallel, the Company continues to ramp up operations and is targeting further production growth, with the goal of commencing gold sales in December. Commercial production is expected by year-end. The achievement of these milestones will further support the Kurmuk Mine’s transition into a significant, low-cost gold-producing operation and Allied Gold’s broader production growth objectives.


**Tsenge Trend Progress**


As disclosed on October 6, 2026, the Tsenge Trend, with a known strike length of 9 kilometres, is emerging as a significant growth opportunity, as multiple higher-grade gold discoveries highlight potential for Mineral Resource growth. Production in the early years at the Kurmuk Mine is planned at a higher level than the life-of-mine average, as mine sequencing takes advantage of near-surface, higher-grade ores from the Ashashire and Dish Mountain open pits. The new high-grade gold zones and ongoing exploration at the Tsenge Trend align with the corporate objective of finding and developing additional sources of higher-grade material to sustain a long-term production profile of 300,000 ounces per year.


While an initial Mineral Resource estimate for the Kiftet and Hiccup Hill zones of the Tsenge Trend is expected by the first half of 2027 and exploration drilling continues to advance along the Tsenge Trend to confirm and extend the higher-grade zones encountered, the Company is advancing the technical work and preparing to initiate the applicable permitting processes to support the future development of the area.


The Tsenge Trend represents an attractive opportunity to expand the Mineral Resource base at Kurmuk, with multiple discoveries located in proximity to the existing processing infrastructure. Importantly, the Tsenge Trend represents just one of several prospective exploration opportunities across Allied Gold’s extensive Kurmuk land package, as highlighted in the Company’s previous exploration update, underscoring the broader potential for continued mineral inventory growth and mine-life extension.


These activities mark an important step in Allied Gold’s strategy to unlock the broader potential of the Kurmuk mineralized system and pursue sustainable, long-term value creation.


**Capital Allocation and Shareholder Returns**


With gold sales from the Kurmuk Mine targeted to commence in December and commercial production expected by year-end, the Company is entering a period of significantly increased free cash flow generation. The Company’s capital allocation priorities are continued investment in growth, including exploration and development at Kurmuk, a strong balance sheet and returns to shareholders. As previously disclosed, returns are expected to include a base dividend starting in 2027 and a normal course issuer bid for up to 10% of the public float, subject to the approval of the Toronto Stock Exchange (“TSX”). The Company intends to file a notice of intention with the TSX in the fourth quarter of 2026 and will announce the commencement date of the bid following acceptance of the notice by the TSX.


**Qualified Person**


Except as otherwise disclosed, all scientific and technical information contained in this press release has been reviewed and approved by Sébastien Bernier, P.Geo (Senior Vice President, Technical Services), a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101. The exploration results referred to in this press release were disclosed in the Company’s press release dated October 6, 2026.


**About Allied Gold Corporation**


Allied Gold is a Canadian-based gold producer with a significant growth profile and mineral endowment, which operates a portfolio of four producing assets located in Côte d’Ivoire, Mali, and Ethiopia. With a significant Mineral Reserve and Mineral Resource base, a strong organic growth pipeline and a proven management team, the Company is positioned to become a leading mid-tier gold producer, with a clear path toward approximately 800,000 ounces of annual production by 2029.
